text:
sophie: Noticing a sudden cluster of fnhook validator rejects on /generate in us-west, start ~14:22. ~15-30x.
kevin: Any errors or sample payloads?
sophie: Log tail:
```
2026-02-05T14:22:11Z validator=fnhook route=/generate region=us-west error=\"schema: expected OBJECT, got LIST\" sample=aa9b1
2026-02-05T14:22:12Z validator=fnhook route=/generate region=us-west error=\"toolcall: missing required 'name'\" sample=aa9b2
```
maria: Pattern looks like top-level lists from multi-step prompts. We recently enabled coercion-permissive for a canary cohort — glue may be mapping lists wrong.
zack: Important: are these hitting billing? If routed as fncall customers could be charged for malformed outputs.
sophie: Current attribution shows billing_tag=fncall, route=default, fallback=degen-fallback. Ops will get alerts.
ops-oncall: If billed, mute alarms while triaging. I can mute the billing alert for /generate us-west for 1h.
maria: Quick triage plan: 1) bump validator sampling to 100% for this route for 10m; 2) rollback coercion-permissive for canary in us-west; 3) patch console: surface validator.shape (OBJECT/LIST) and show one example payload inline.
kevin: I'll flip sampling and rollback via rollout console now. Deploy-bot, enqueue rollback for coercion-permissive canary us-west by kevin.
deploy-bot: rollback job queued (id=10021) by kevin — expected complete ~14:24.
sophie: UX ask: console 'rejected' tag is not actionable. Small change: show \"shape: LIST\" badge and a clickable sample id that opens payload. Also add a transient metric validator.shape_type{route,region} so dashboards can graph spikes.
maria: And we should add a billing_exempt signal for soft-degrades so billing alarms can be suppressed automatically when fallback==degen. Filing ENG-19555 for dashboard + metric + billing-exempt flag.
kevin: Adding 3 saved samples to ENG-19555 after sampling ramps.
sophie: Post-rollback quick checks: rejects dropping. Keeping 100% sampling for 10m and will paste samples. Thread_ts=1769999990. :thumbsup:
